verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent automation, not a rule engine. Slack messages and GitHub issues can be brought into kanban with responses returned to the source thread. A run-until-completion script repeats iterations while open kanban work remains, and workflows can be saved as reusable YAML. None of this shows user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events, and the docs say Workflow records are stored but not executed. Missing for 10: a documented event-trigger or rule definition mechanism, a list of supported event types, automatic action execution on those triggers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
